engine: Godot 4.5.1 Compatibility / OpenGL 3.3 NVIDIA RTX A400
evidence_type: Actual unmodified desktop runtime viewport captures of the 200-chamber expansion, with direct chamber-selection fixtures.
summary: 42 genuine expansion captures: home, map, all ten biomes, workshop and results at three portrait viewport sizes. Direct selection fixtures are not manual campaign play. All images visually reviewed; no blocking clipping, missing glyphs or playfield obstruction found. Some scenery behind long headings reduces local contrast without hiding the text. A later final-chamber button wording correction is absent from these frames; the original captured hashes and exact-change attestation are retained. Native evidence below remains historical Nov13 APK footage; no expansion Android or physical-device play is claimed.

scope_limits: Workshop screenshots show initial scroll positions, not all six cards at once.
Map screenshots show Amber Hollow and its initial scroll position, not every campaign title.
Viewport dimensions do not prove physical-device testing.
